comment: Mutant pqxdh-kem-ss-omitted: pqxdh_initiate and pqxdh_accept invoke ML-KEM encapsulate/decapsulate but omit appending the 32-byte KEM shared secret ss to the PQXDH KDF input. Alice initiates and sends a PreKeySignalMessage; an active adversary modifies a byte of kyber_ciphertext on the wire, and Bob still accepts and decrypts the message.
